[114](#114)
[115](#115)#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
[116](#116)pub fn init_with_passphrase(
[117](#117)    path: &Path,
[118](#118)    backend: &str,
[119](#119)    compression_algo: &str,
[120](#120)    chunker_mode: &str,
[121](#121)    chunk_size: Option<u64>,
[122](#122)    is_private: bool,
[123](#123)    json: bool,
[124](#124)    passphrase: &str,
[125](#125)) -> Result<()> {
[126](#126)    crate::metrics::METRICS
[127](#127)        .ops_init
[128](#128)        .fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
[129](#129)    let _guard = OP_QUEUES
[130](#130)        .get_or_create(&path.to_path_buf())
[131](#131)        .acquire(ops::OpKind::Write, "init".to_string());
[132](#132)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[133](#133)    if shard_dir.exists() {
[134](#134)        anyhow::bail!(
[135](#135)            "repository already initialized at {} (run `shard status` to confirm)",
[136](#136)            shard_dir.display()
[137](#137)        );
[138](#138)    }
[139](#139)    fs::create_dir_all(shard_dir.join("objects"))?;
[140](#140)    fs::create_dir_all(shard_dir.join("keys"))?;
[141](#141)    fs::create_dir_all(shard_dir.join("refs").join("heads"))?;
[142](#142)    branch::set_head_branch(&shard_dir, "main")?;
[143](#143)
[144](#144)    let keys = KeyPair::generate();
[145](#145)    keys.save_with_passphrase(&shard_dir.join("keys"), passphrase)?;
[146](#146)    if !passphrase.is_empty() {
[147](#147)        cache_passphrase(passphrase)?;
[148](#148)    }
[149](#149)    if let Some(global) = global_keys_dir() {
[150](#150)        fs::create_dir_all(&global).ok();
[151](#151)        let _ = keys.save_with_passphrase(&global, passphrase);
[152](#152)        let _ = keychain::init_keychain(&global);
[153](#153)    }
[154](#154)    keychain::init_keychain(&shard_dir.join("keys"))?;
[155](#155)
[156](#156)    let pubkey = fs::read(shard_dir.join("keys/public.key"))?;
[159](#159)    let repo_id = blake3::hash(&pubkey).to_hex().to_string();
[160](#160)    let mut config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[161](#161)
[162](#162)    if is_private {
[163](#163)        let key = encryption::generate_repo_key();
[164](#164)        encryption::save_repo_key(&shard_dir.join("keys"), &key)?;
[165](#165)        config.insert("private".to_string(), "true".to_string());
[166](#166)    }
[167](#167)    config.insert("repo_id".to_string(), repo_id);
[168](#168)    config.insert("storage_backend".to_string(), backend.to_string());
[169](#169)    config.insert(
[170](#170)        "serialization_format".to_string(),
[171](#171)        MetadataFormat::Json.config_value().to_string(),
[172](#172)    );
[173](#173)    config.insert("compression".to_string(), compression_algo.to_string());
[174](#174)    config.insert("chunker_mode".to_string(), chunker_mode.to_string());
[175](#175)    match chunker_mode {
[176](#176)        "rabin" => {
[177](#177)            let chunk_size = chunk_size.unwrap_or(4_194_304);
[178](#178)            let min = chunk_size / 4;
[179](#179)            let max = chunk_size * 2;
[180](#180)            config.insert("chunk_min".to_string(), min.to_string());
[181](#181)            config.insert("chunk_avg".to_string(), chunk_size.to_string());
[182](#182)            config.insert("chunk_max".to_string(), max.to_string());
[183](#183)        }
[184](#184)        _ => {
[185](#185)            let cs = chunk_size.unwrap_or(4_194_304);
[186](#186)            config.insert("chunk_size".to_string(), cs.to_string());
[187](#187)        }
[188](#188)    }
[189](#189)    save_config(&shard_dir, &config)?;
[190](#190)
[191](#191)    let chunker_desc = if chunker_mode == "rabin" {
[192](#192)        format!(
[193](#193)            "rabin (avg {} bytes)",
[194](#194)            config.get("chunk_avg").unwrap_or(&"4 MiB".to_string())
[195](#195)        )
[196](#196)    } else {
[197](#197)        format!(
[198](#198)            "fixed ({} bytes)",
[199](#199)            config.get("chunk_size").unwrap_or(&"4 MiB".to_string())
[200](#200)        )
[201](#201)    };
[202](#202)    if json {
[203](#203)        info!(
[204](#204)            "{}",
[205](#205)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[206](#206)                "path": shard_dir.display().to_string(),
[207](#207)                "backend": backend,
[208](#208)                "compression": compression_algo,
[209](#209)                "chunker": chunker_desc,
[210](#210)                "private": is_private,
[211](#211)            }))?
[212](#212)        );
[213](#213)    } else {
[214](#214)        info!(
[215](#215)            "Initialized empty Shard repository in {} with {} storage (compression: {}, chunking: {})",
[216](#216)            shard_dir.display(),
[217](#217)            backend,
[218](#218)            compression_algo,
[219](#219)            chunker_desc,
[220](#220)        );
[221](#221)    }
[222](#222)    Ok(())
[223](#223)}
[224](#224)
[225](#225)fn relative_path(repo_root: &Path, file_path: &Path) -> String {
[226](#226)    let repo = repo_root
[227](#227)        .canonicalize()
[228](#228)        .unwrap_or_else(|_| repo_root.to_path_buf());
[229](#229)    let file = file_path
[230](#230)        .canonicalize()
[231](#231)        .unwrap_or_else(|_| file_path.to_path_buf());
[232](#232)    file.strip_prefix(&repo)
[233](#233)        .map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string())
[234](#234)        .unwrap_or_else(|_| {
[235](#235)            file_path
[236](#236)                .file_name()
[237](#237)                .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string())
[238](#238)                .unwrap_or_default()
[239](#239)        })
[240](#240)}
[241](#241)
[242](#242)fn detect_content_type(file_path: &Path) -> Option<String> {
[243](#243)    let ext = file_path.extension()?.to_str()?.to_lowercase();
[244](#244)    let mime = match ext.as_str() {
[245](#245)        "txt" => "text/plain",
[246](#246)        "json" => "application/json",
[247](#247)        "csv" => "text/csv",
[248](#248)        "png" => "image/png",
[249](#249)        "jpg" | "jpeg" => "image/jpeg",
[250](#250)        "gif" => "image/gif",
[251](#251)        "pdf" => "application/pdf",
[252](#252)        "yaml" | "yml" => "application/x-yaml",
[253](#253)        "md" => "text/markdown",
[254](#254)        "html" | "htm" => "text/html",
[255](#255)        "py" => "text/x-python",
[256](#256)        "rs" => "text/x-rust",
[257](#257)        "ts" => "text/x-typescript",
[258](#258)        "js" => "application/javascript",
[259](#259)        "wasm" => "application/wasm",
[260](#260)        "toml" => "application/toml",
[261](#261)        "xml" => "application/xml",
[262](#262)        "zip" => "application/zip",
[263](#263)        "tar" => "application/x-tar",
[264](#264)        "gz" => "application/gzip",
[265](#265)        "bin" => "application/octet-stream",
[266](#266)        "pt" | "pth" | "ckpt" | "safetensors" => "application/x-model",
[267](#267)        _ => return None,
[268](#268)    };
[269](#269)    Some(mime.to_string())
[270](#270)}
[271](#271)
[272](#272)#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
[273](#273)fn add_file(
[274](#274)    repo_root: &Path,
[275](#275)    file_path: &Path,
[276](#276)    store: &Store,
[277](#277)    index: &mut Index,
[278](#278)    compression: &Compression,
[279](#279)    chunker_mode: &chunker::ChunkerMode,
[280](#280)    cipher: Option<&encryption::RepoCipher>,
[281](#281)    _json: bool,
[282](#282)) -> Result<()> {
[283](#283)    let file = fs::File::open(file_path)?;
[284](#284)    let mut chunker = match chunker_mode {
[285](#285)        chunker::ChunkerMode::Fixed { chunk_size } => {
[286](#286)            chunker::Chunker::new_fixed(Box::new(file), *chunk_size)
[287](#287)        }
[288](#288)        chunker::ChunkerMode::Rabin { min, avg, max } => {
[289](#289)            chunker::Chunker::new_rabin(Box::new(file), *min, *avg, *max)
[290](#290)        }
[291](#291)    };
[292](#292)    let mut chunk_hashes = Vec::new();
[293](#293)    let mut total_size = 0;
[294](#294)
[295](#295)    while let Some(chunk) = chunker.next_chunk()? {
[296](#296)        let hash = chunk.hash;
[297](#297)        let compressed_data = compression.compress(&chunk.data)?;
[298](#298)        let stored_data = match cipher {
[299](#299)            Some(c) => c.encrypt(&compressed_data),
[300](#300)            None => compressed_data,
[301](#301)        };
[302](#302)        let stored = crate::chunker::Chunk {
[303](#303)            hash,
[304](#304)            data: stored_data,
[305](#305)            offset: chunk.offset,
[306](#306)        };
[307](#307)        store.put_chunk(&stored)?;
[308](#308)        chunk_hashes.push(hash.to_hex().to_string());
[309](#309)        total_size += chunk.data.len() as u64;
[310](#310)    }
[311](#311)
[312](#312)    let name = relative_path(repo_root, file_path);
[313](#313)    let manifest = FileManifest {
[314](#314)        name: name.clone(),
[315](#315)        size: total_size,
[316](#316)        chunks: chunk_hashes.clone(),
[317](#317)        content_type: detect_content_type(file_path),
[318](#318)        compression: compression.as_str().to_string(),
[319](#319)        merkle_root: Some(FileManifest::merkle_root(&chunk_hashes)),
[320](#320)        created_by: None,
[321](#321)        created_at: None,
[322](#322)        signature: None,
[323](#323)    };
[324](#324)
[325](#325)    index.files.insert(name.clone(), manifest);
[326](#326)    if !_json {
[327](#327)        info!("Added {} ({})", name, total_size);
[328](#328)    }
[329](#329)    Ok(())
[330](#330)}
[331](#331)
[332](#332)pub fn recover(path: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[333](#333)    crate::metrics::METRICS
[334](#334)        .ops_recover
[335](#335)        .fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
[336](#336)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[337](#337)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[338](#338)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[339](#339)    }
[340](#340)    wal::recover(&shard_dir)?;
[341](#341)    if json {
[342](#342)        info!(
[343](#343)            "{}",
[344](#344)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"status": "recovery complete"}))?
[345](#345)        );
[346](#346)    } else {
[347](#347)        info!("Recovery complete.");
[348](#348)    }
[349](#349)    Ok(())
[350](#350)}
[351](#351)
[352](#352)pub fn health(path: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[353](#353)    use crate::metrics::METRICS;
[354](#354)    METRICS
[355](#355)        .ops_health
[356](#356)        .fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
[357](#357)
[358](#358)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[359](#359)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[360](#360)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[361](#361)    }
[362](#362)
[363](#363)    let mut issues: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
[364](#364)
[365](#365)    let objects_ok = shard_dir.join("objects").exists();
[366](#366)    if !objects_ok {
[367](#367)        issues.push("objects directory missing".to_string());
[368](#368)    }
[369](#369)
[370](#370)    let config_ok = shard_dir.join("config.json").exists();
[371](#371)    let _config: Option<std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>> = if config_ok {
[372](#372)        match load_config(&shard_dir) {
[373](#373)            Ok(c) => Some(c),
[374](#374)            Err(e) => {
[375](#375)                issues.push(format!("config.json corrupt: {}", e));
[376](#376)                None
[377](#377)            }
[378](#378)        }
[379](#379)    } else {
[380](#380)        issues.push("config.json missing".to_string());
[381](#381)        None
[382](#382)    };
[383](#383)
[384](#384)    let keys_dir = shard_dir.join("keys");
[385](#385)    let keys_ok = keys_dir.join("secret.key").exists() && keys_dir.join("public.key").exists();
[386](#386)    if !keys_ok {
[387](#387)        issues.push("keys missing (secret.key and/or public.key)".to_string());
[388](#388)    }
[389](#389)
[390](#390)    let wal_has_entries = shard_dir.join("wal.log").exists() && {
[391](#391)        std::fs::metadata(shard_dir.join("wal.log"))
[392](#392)            .map(|m| m.len() > 0)
[393](#393)            .unwrap_or(false)
[394](#394)    };
[395](#395)
[396](#396)    let store_result = Store::open(&shard_dir);
[397](#397)    let object_count = match &store_result {
[398](#398)        Ok(store) => store.iter_chunks().map(|c| c.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0),
[399](#399)        Err(e) => {
[400](#400)            issues.push(format!("store error: {}", e));
[401](#401)            0
[402](#402)        }
[403](#403)    };
[404](#404)
[405](#405)    let (branch, head) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)
[406](#406)        .ok()
[407](#407)        .unwrap_or((None, None));
[408](#408)
[409](#409)    let branch_count = branch::list_branches(&shard_dir)
[410](#410)        .map(|(_, b)| b.len() as u64)
[411](#411)        .unwrap_or(0);
[412](#412)
[413](#413)    let tags_count = load_tags(&shard_dir).map(|t| t.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0);
[414](#414)
[415](#415)    let disk_usage = dir_size(&shard_dir);
[416](#416)
[417](#417)    let key_valid = load_keypair(&shard_dir).is_ok();
[418](#418)
[419](#419)    let metrics_snapshot = crate::metrics::METRICS.snapshot();
[420](#420)
[421](#421)    if json {
[422](#422)        info!(
[423](#423)            "{}",
[424](#424)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[425](#425)                "status": if issues.is_empty() { "healthy" } else { "degraded" },
[426](#426)                "shard_dir": shard_dir.display().to_string(),
[427](#427)                "objects_ok": objects_ok,
[428](#428)                "config_ok": config_ok,
[429](#429)                "keys_ok": keys_ok && key_valid,
[430](#430)                "wal_pending": wal_has_entries,
[431](#431)                "object_count": object_count,
[432](#432)                "current_branch": branch,
[433](#433)                "head_commit": head,
[434](#434)                "branch_count": branch_count,
[435](#435)                "tag_count": tags_count,
[436](#436)                "disk_usage_bytes": disk_usage,
[437](#437)                "issues": issues,
[438](#438)                "metrics": metrics_snapshot,
[439](#439)            }))?
[440](#440)        );
[441](#441)    } else {
[442](#442)        if issues.is_empty() {
[443](#443)            info!("Health: OK");
[444](#444)        } else {
[445](#445)            info!("Health: DEGRADED");
[446](#446)            for issue in &issues {
[447](#447)                warn!("  - {}", issue);
[448](#448)            }
[449](#449)        }
[450](#450)        info!("  Objects: {}", object_count);
[451](#451)        info!("  Branches: {}, Tags: {}", branch_count, tags_count);
[452](#452)        info!("  Current branch: {:?}", branch);
[453](#453)        info!("  HEAD: {:?}", head);
[454](#454)        info!("  WAL pending: {}", wal_has_entries);
[455](#455)        info!("  Disk usage: {} bytes", disk_usage);
[456](#456)    }
[457](#457)
[458](#458)    if !issues.is_empty() {
[459](#459)        anyhow::bail!("health check found {} issue(s)", issues.len());
[460](#460)    }
[461](#461)    Ok(())
[462](#462)}
[463](#463)
[464](#464)fn dir_size(path: &Path) -> u64 {
[465](#465)    ignore::WalkBuilder::new(path)
[466](#466)        .hidden(false)
[467](#467)        .ignore(false)
[468](#468)        .git_ignore(false)
[469](#469)        .build()
[470](#470)        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
[471](#471)        .filter(|e| e.file_type().is_some_and(|ft| ft.is_file()))
[472](#472)        .filter_map(|e| e.metadata().ok())
[473](#473)        .map(|m| m.len())
[474](#474)        .sum()
[475](#475)}
[476](#476)
[477](#477)pub fn get_metrics() -> metrics::MetricsSnapshot {
[478](#478)    crate::metrics::METRICS.snapshot()
[479](#479)}
[480](#480)
[481](#481)pub fn add(path: &Path, file_path: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[482](#482)    crate::metrics::METRICS
[483](#483)        .ops_add
[484](#484)        .fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
[485](#485)    let _guard = OP_QUEUES
[486](#486)        .get_or_create(&path.to_path_buf())
[487](#487)        .acquire(ops::OpKind::Write, "add".to_string());
[488](#488)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[489](#489)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[490](#490)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[491](#491)    }
[492](#492)
[493](#493)    wal::recover(&shard_dir)?;
[494](#494)
[495](#495)    let config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[496](#496)    let compression: Compression = config
[497](#497)        .get("compression")
[498](#498)        .map(|s| s.as_str())
[499](#499)        .unwrap_or("zstd")
[500](#500)        .parse()?;
[501](#501)
[502](#502)    let chunker_mode = chunker::ChunkerMode::from_config(&config);
[503](#503)    let fmt = MetadataFormat::from_config(&config);
[504](#504)
[505](#505)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[506](#506)    let mut index = Index::load(&shard_dir.join("index"), &fmt)?;
[507](#507)
[508](#508)    let cipher = maybe_load_cipher(&shard_dir)?;
[509](#509)    let include_hidden = config
[510](#510)        .get("hidden_files_enabled")
[511](#511)        .map(|s| s.as_str() == "true")
[512](#512)        .unwrap_or(false);
[513](#513)
[514](#514)    if file_path.is_dir() {
[515](#515)        let mut builder = ignore::WalkBuilder::new(file_path);
[516](#516)        builder.hidden(!include_hidden);
[517](#517)        builder.add_custom_ignore_filename(".shardignore");
[518](#518)        builder.filter_entry(|e| {
[519](#519)            let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy();
[520](#520)            if name == ".shard" || name == ".git" {
[521](#521)                return false;
[522](#522)            }
[523](#523)            true
[524](#524)        });
[525](#525)
[526](#526)        for entry in builder.build() {
[527](#527)            let entry = entry.map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("{}", e))?;
[528](#528)            if entry.file_type().is_some_and(|ft| ft.is_file()) {
[529](#529)                add_file(
[530](#530)                    path,
[531](#531)                    entry.path(),
[532](#532)                    &store,
[533](#533)                    &mut index,
[534](#534)                    &compression,
[535](#535)                    &chunker_mode,
[536](#536)                    cipher.as_ref(),
[537](#537)                    json,
[538](#538)                )?;
[539](#539)            }
[540](#540)        }
[541](#541)    } else {
[542](#542)        add_file(
[543](#543)            path,
[544](#544)            file_path,
[545](#545)            &store,
[546](#546)            &mut index,
[547](#547)            &compression,
[548](#548)            &chunker_mode,
[549](#549)            cipher.as_ref(),
[550](#550)            json,
[551](#551)        )?;
[552](#552)    }
[553](#553)
[554](#554)    index.save(&shard_dir.join("index"), &fmt)?;
[555](#555)    if json {
[556](#556)        info!(
[557](#557)            "{}",
[558](#558)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"status": "added"}))?
[559](#559)        );
[560](#560)    }
[561](#561)    Ok(())
[562](#562)}
[563](#563)
[564](#564)pub fn commit(path: &Path, message: &str, author: &str, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[565](#565)    let _guard = OP_QUEUES
[566](#566)        .get_or_create(&path.to_path_buf())
[567](#567)        .acquire(ops::OpKind::Write, "commit".to_string());
[568](#568)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[569](#569)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[570](#570)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[571](#571)    }
[572](#572)
[573](#573)    wal::recover(&shard_dir)?;
[575](#575)
[576](#576)    let config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[577](#577)    let fmt = MetadataFormat::from_config(&config);
[578](#578)
[579](#579)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[580](#580)    let mut index = Index::load(&shard_dir.join("index"), &fmt)?;
[581](#581)
[582](#582)    if index.files.is_empty() {
[583](#583)        anyhow::bail!("nothing to commit (stage files with `shard add` first)");
[584](#584)    }
[585](#585)
[586](#586)    let head_path = shard_dir.join("HEAD");
[587](#587)
[588](#588)    let wal = wal::Wal::new(&shard_dir);
[590](#590)    let head_backup = fs::read_to_string(&head_path).ok();
[591](#591)    let index_backup = fs::read(shard_dir.join("index"))?;
[592](#592)    wal.append(&wal::WalEntry::CommitBegin {
[593](#593)        head_backup,
[594](#594)        index_backup,
[595](#595)    })?;
[596](#596)
[597](#597)    let timestamp = SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)?.as_secs();
[599](#599)    let keys = load_keypair(&shard_dir)?;
[600](#600)    let signing_key = keys.signing_key;
[601](#601)    let mut manifest_ids = Vec::new();
[602](#602)    for manifest in index.files.values_mut() {
[603](#603)        manifest.created_by = Some(author.to_string());
[604](#604)        manifest.created_at = Some(timestamp);
[605](#605)
[606](#606)        let mut unsigned = manifest.clone();
[607](#607)        unsigned.signature = None;
[608](#608)        let canonical = metadata::serialize_for_signing(&unsigned);
[609](#609)        let sig = signing_key.sign(&canonical);
[610](#610)        manifest.signature = Some(hex::encode(sig.to_bytes()));
[611](#611)
[612](#612)        let encoded = metadata::serialize(manifest, &fmt);
[613](#613)        let hash = blake3::hash(&encoded);
[614](#614)        let chunk = crate::chunker::Chunk {
[615](#615)            hash,
[616](#616)            data: encoded,
[617](#617)            offset: 0,
[618](#618)        };
[619](#619)        store.put_chunk(&chunk)?;
[620](#620)        manifest_ids.push(hash.to_hex().to_string());
[621](#621)    }
[622](#622)    manifest_ids.sort();
[623](#623)
[624](#624)    let mut parents = Vec::new();
[626](#626)    let (current_branch, parent_id) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?;
[627](#627)    if let Some(pid) = parent_id {
[628](#628)        parents.push(pid);
[629](#629)    }
[630](#630)
[631](#631)    let public_key_hex = hex::encode(keys.verifying_key.to_bytes());
[633](#633)    let key_id = keychain::get_current_key_id(&shard_dir.join("keys")).ok();
[634](#634)    let mut commit = Commit {
[635](#635)        commit_id: String::new(),
[636](#636)        parents,
[637](#637)        manifests: manifest_ids,
[638](#638)        author: author.to_string(),
[639](#639)        message: message.to_string(),
[640](#640)        timestamp,
[641](#641)        public_key: Some(public_key_hex),
[642](#642)        signature: None,
[643](#643)        key_id,
[644](#644)    };
[645](#645)
[646](#646)    let json_unsigned = metadata::serialize_for_signing(&commit);
[648](#648)    let signature = signing_key.sign(&json_unsigned);
[649](#649)    commit.signature = Some(hex::encode(signature.to_bytes()));
[650](#650)
[651](#651)    let encoded = metadata::serialize(&commit, &fmt);
[653](#653)    let hash = blake3::hash(&encoded);
[654](#654)    let chunk = crate::chunker::Chunk {
[655](#655)        hash,
[656](#656)        data: encoded,
[657](#657)        offset: 0,
[658](#658)    };
[659](#659)    store.put_chunk(&chunk)?;
[660](#660)
[661](#661)    let commit_id = hash.to_hex().to_string();
[663](#663)    if has_dag_cycle(&store, &commit.parents, &commit_id)? {
[664](#664)        anyhow::bail!(
[665](#665)            "Cycle detected: commit {} is already an ancestor of one or more parents",
[666](#666)            commit_id
[667](#667)        );
[668](#668)    }
[669](#669)
[670](#670)    if let Some(ref branch_name) = current_branch {
[672](#672)        branch::update_branch_ref(&shard_dir, branch_name, &commit_id)?;
[673](#673)        branch::set_head_branch(&shard_dir, branch_name)?;
[674](#674)    } else {
[675](#675)        fs::write(&head_path, &commit_id)?;
[676](#676)    }
[677](#677)
[678](#678)    index.files.clear();
[680](#680)    index.save(&shard_dir.join("index"), &fmt)?;
[681](#681)
[682](#682)    wal.append(&wal::WalEntry::CommitEnd)?;
[684](#684)    wal.truncate()?;
[685](#685)
[686](#686)    if json {
[687](#687)        info!(
[688](#688)            "{}",
[689](#689)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[690](#690)                "commit_id": commit_id,
[691](#691)                "message": message,
[692](#692)            }))?
[693](#693)        );
[694](#694)    } else {
[695](#695)        info!("Committed {} ({})", commit_id, message);
[696](#696)    }
[697](#697)    Ok(())
[698](#698)}
[699](#699)
[700](#700)pub fn verify(path: &Path, commit_id: &str, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[701](#701)    let _guard = OP_QUEUES
[702](#702)        .get_or_create(&path.to_path_buf())
[703](#703)        .acquire(ops::OpKind::Read, "verify".to_string());
[704](#704)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[705](#705)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[706](#706)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[707](#707)    }
[708](#708)
[709](#709)    if commit_id.len() < 2 {
[710](#710)        anyhow::bail!("invalid commit id (too short: need at least 2 characters)");
[711](#711)    }
[712](#712)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[713](#713)    let cipher = maybe_load_cipher(&shard_dir)?;
[714](#714)    let commit_data = store.get_chunk(commit_id)?;
[715](#715)
[716](#716)    let stored_hash = blake3::hash(&commit_data);
[718](#718)    if stored_hash.to_hex().to_string() != commit_id {
[719](#719)        anyhow::bail!("commit object hash mismatch: stored content does not match its hash — data may be corrupted");
[720](#720)    }
[721](#721)
[722](#722)    let commit: Commit = metadata::deserialize(&commit_data)?;
[723](#723)
[724](#724)    let mut sig_verified = false;
[725](#725)    let mut files_checked = 0u64;
[726](#726)
[727](#727)    if let Some(kid) = &commit.key_id {
[729](#729)        if let Err(e) = keychain::key_was_valid_at(&shard_dir.join("keys"), kid, commit.timestamp) {
[730](#730)            anyhow::bail!("Keychain verification failed: {}", e);
[731](#731)        } else if !json {
[732](#732)            info!("Keychain: key {} was active at commit time.", kid);
[733](#733)        }
[734](#734)    }
[735](#735)
[736](#736)    if let Some(sig_hex) = &commit.signature {
[737](#737)        let verifying_key = if let Some(pk_hex) = &commit.public_key {
[738](#738)            let pk_bytes = hex::decode(pk_hex)?;
[739](#739)            ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::from_bytes(pk_bytes.as_slice().try_into()?)?
[740](#740)        } else {
[741](#741)            let pub_bytes = load_public_key(&shard_dir)?;
[742](#742)            ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::from_bytes(pub_bytes.as_slice().try_into()?)?
[743](#743)        };
[744](#744)
[745](#745)        let mut unsigned_commit = commit.clone();
[746](#746)        unsigned_commit.signature = None;
[747](#747)        let json_unsigned = metadata::serialize_for_signing(&unsigned_commit);
[748](#748)
[749](#749)        let sig_bytes = hex::decode(sig_hex)?;
[750](#750)        let signature = ed25519_dalek::Signature::from_bytes(sig_bytes.as_slice().try_into()?);
[751](#751)
[752](#752)        verifying_key.verify(&json_unsigned, &signature)?;
[753](#753)        sig_verified = true;
[754](#754)        if !json {
[755](#755)            info!("Signature verified.");
[756](#756)        }
[757](#757)    } else if !json {
[758](#758)        info!("Warning: Commit is unsigned.");
[759](#759)    }
[760](#760)
[761](#761)    for manifest_id in &commit.manifests {
[762](#762)        let manifest_data = store.get_chunk(manifest_id)?;
[763](#763)        let hash = blake3::hash(&manifest_data);
[764](#764)        if hash.to_hex().to_string() != *manifest_id {
[765](#765)            anyhow::bail!("manifest object hash mismatch for manifest '{}': content does not match stored hash. The object store may be corrupted.", manifest_id);
[766](#766)        }
[767](#767)
[768](#768)        let manifest: FileManifest = metadata::deserialize(&manifest_data)?;
[769](#769)
[770](#770)        if let Some(sig_hex) = &manifest.signature {
[772](#772)            let pk_bytes = if let Some(pk_hex) = &commit.public_key {
[773](#773)                hex::decode(pk_hex)?
[774](#774)            } else {
[775](#775)                load_public_key(&shard_dir)?
[776](#776)            };
[777](#777)            let vk = ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::from_bytes(pk_bytes.as_slice().try_into()?)?;
[778](#778)            let mut unsigned = manifest.clone();
[779](#779)            unsigned.signature = None;
[780](#780)            let canonical = metadata::serialize_for_signing(&unsigned);
[781](#781)            let sig_bytes = hex::decode(sig_hex)?;
[782](#782)            let sig = ed25519_dalek::Signature::from_bytes(sig_bytes.as_slice().try_into()?);
[783](#783)            vk.verify(&canonical, &sig)?;
[784](#784)            if !json {
[785](#785)                info!("  Manifest signature verified for: {}", manifest.name);
[786](#786)            }
[787](#787)        }
[788](#788)
[789](#789)        let compression = manifest.compression.parse::<Compression>()?;
[790](#790)        if !json {
[791](#791)            info!(
[792](#792)                "Verifying file: {} (compression: {})",
[793](#793)                manifest.name, manifest.compression
[794](#794)            );
[795](#795)        }
[796](#796)
[797](#797)        if let Some(ref mr) = manifest.merkle_root {
[799](#799)            let computed = FileManifest::merkle_root(&manifest.chunks);
[800](#800)            if mr != &computed {
[801](#801)                anyhow::bail!(
[802](#802)                    "merkle root mismatch for '{}': manifest says {} but computed {}",
[803](#803)                    manifest.name,
[804](#804)                    mr,
[805](#805)                    computed
[806](#806)                );
[807](#807)            }
[808](#808)        }
[809](#809)
[810](#810)        for chunk_id in &manifest.chunks {
[811](#811)            let chunk_data = store.get_chunk(chunk_id)?;
[812](#812)            let decrypted = match &cipher {
[813](#813)                Some(c) => c.decrypt(&chunk_data)?,
[814](#814)                None => chunk_data,
[815](#815)            };
[816](#816)            let decompressed = compression.decompress(&decrypted)?;
[817](#817)            let hash = blake3::hash(&decompressed);
[818](#818)            if hash.to_hex().to_string() != *chunk_id {
[819](#819)                anyhow::bail!("chunk hash mismatch for '{}': content does not match stored hash (expected {}, got {}). File may be corrupted.", manifest.name, chunk_id, hash.to_hex());
[820](#820)            }
[821](#821)        }
[822](#822)        files_checked += 1;
[823](#823)    }
[824](#824)
[825](#825)    if json {
[826](#826)        info!(
[827](#827)            "{}",
[828](#828)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[829](#829)                "commit_id": commit_id,
[830](#830)                "verified": true,
[831](#831)                "signature_verified": sig_verified,
[832](#832)                "files_checked": files_checked,
[833](#833)            }))?
[834](#834)        );
[835](#835)    } else {
[836](#836)        info!("Verification successful.");
[837](#837)    }
[838](#838)    Ok(())
[839](#839)}
[840](#840)
[841](#841)fn load_commit(store: &Store, commit_id: &str) -> Result<Commit> {
[842](#842)    if commit_id.len() < 2 {
[843](#843)        anyhow::bail!(
[844](#844)            "commit id too short (got {} chars, need at least 2): '{}'",
[845](#845)            commit_id.len(),
[846](#846)            commit_id
[847](#847)        );
[848](#848)    };
[849](#849)    let data = store.get_chunk(commit_id)?;
[850](#850)    let mut commit: Commit = metadata::deserialize(&data)?;
[851](#851)    commit.commit_id = commit_id.to_string();
[852](#852)    Ok(commit)
[853](#853)}
[854](#854)
[855](#855)fn has_dag_cycle(store: &Store, parents: &[String], commit_id: &str) -> Result<bool> {
[856](#856)    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
[857](#857)    let mut stack: Vec<String> = parents.to_vec();
[858](#858)    while let Some(cid) = stack.pop() {
[859](#859)        if cid == commit_id {
[860](#860)            return Ok(true);
[861](#861)        }
[862](#862)        if !seen.insert(cid.clone()) {
[863](#863)            continue;
[864](#864)        }
[865](#865)        if let Ok(data) = store.get_chunk(&cid) {
[866](#866)            if let Ok(commit) = metadata::deserialize::<Commit>(&data) {
[867](#867)                for p in &commit.parents {
[868](#868)                    stack.push(p.clone());
[869](#869)                }
[870](#870)            }
[871](#871)        }
[872](#872)    }
[873](#873)    Ok(false)
[874](#874)}
[875](#875)
[876](#876)#[derive(Serialize)]
[877](#877)pub struct LogEntry {
[878](#878)    pub commit_id: String,
[879](#879)    pub parents: Vec<String>,
[880](#880)    pub manifests: Vec<String>,
[881](#881)    pub author: String,
[882](#882)    pub message: String,
[883](#883)    pub timestamp: u64,
[884](#884)    pub signature: Option<String>,
[885](#885)}
[886](#886)
[887](#887)impl From<Commit> for LogEntry {
[888](#888)    fn from(c: Commit) -> Self {
[889](#889)        LogEntry {
[890](#890)            commit_id: c.commit_id,
[891](#891)            parents: c.parents,
[892](#892)            manifests: c.manifests,
[893](#893)            author: c.author,
[894](#894)            message: c.message,
[895](#895)            timestamp: c.timestamp,
[896](#896)            signature: c.signature,
[897](#897)        }
[898](#898)    }
[899](#899)}
[900](#900)
[901](#901)pub fn log_cmd(path: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[902](#902)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[903](#903)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[904](#904)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[905](#905)    }
[906](#906)
[907](#907)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[908](#908)
[909](#909)    let (_, head_commit) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?;
[910](#910)    let head = head_commit
[911](#911)        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("no commits yet (run `shard commit` after adding files)"))?;
[912](#912)
[913](#913)    let mut entries: Vec<LogEntry> = Vec::new();
[914](#914)    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
[915](#915)    let mut stack = vec![head];
[916](#916)
[917](#917)    while let Some(cid) = stack.pop() {
[918](#918)        if !seen.insert(cid.clone()) {
[919](#919)            continue;
[920](#920)        }
[921](#921)        let commit = load_commit(&store, &cid)?;
[922](#922)        for parent in &commit.parents {
[923](#923)            stack.push(parent.clone());
[924](#924)        }
[925](#925)        entries.push(commit.into());
[926](#926)    }
[927](#927)
[928](#928)    if json {
[929](#929)        info!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&entries)?);
[930](#930)    } else {
[931](#931)        for entry in &entries {
[932](#932)            let ts = {
[933](#933)                let secs = entry.timestamp as i64;
[934](#934)                let tm = time::OffsetDateTime::from_unix_timestamp(secs)
[935](#935)                    .unwrap_or(time::OffsetDateTime::UNIX_EPOCH);
[936](#936)                tm.format(&time::format_description::well_known::Rfc3339)
[937](#937)                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| entry.timestamp.to_string())
[938](#938)            };
[939](#939)            info!("commit {}", entry.commit_id);
[940](#940)            if !entry.parents.is_empty() {
[941](#941)                info!("parents: {}", entry.parents.join(" "));
[942](#942)            }
[943](#943)            info!("author: {}", entry.author);
[944](#944)            info!("date:   {}", ts);
[945](#945)            info!("");
[946](#946)            for line in entry.message.lines() {
[947](#947)                info!("    {}", line);
[948](#948)            }
[949](#949)            info!("");
[950](#950)        }
[951](#951)    }
[952](#952)
[953](#953)    Ok(())
[954](#954)}
[955](#955)
[956](#956)fn reconstruct_file(
[957](#957)    store: &Store,
[958](#958)    manifest: &FileManifest,
[959](#959)    cipher: Option<&encryption::RepoCipher>,
[960](#960)) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
[961](#961)    let compression: Compression = manifest.compression.parse()?;
[962](#962)    let mut data = Vec::new();
[963](#963)    for chunk_id in &manifest.chunks {
[964](#964)        let chunk_data = store.get_chunk(chunk_id)?;
[965](#965)        let decrypted = match cipher {
[966](#966)            Some(c) => c.decrypt(&chunk_data)?,
[967](#967)            None => chunk_data,
[968](#968)        };
[969](#969)        let decompressed = compression.decompress(&decrypted)?;
[970](#970)        data.extend_from_slice(&decompressed);
[971](#971)    }
[972](#972)    Ok(data)
[973](#973)}
[974](#974)
[975](#975)pub fn diff(path: &Path, commit_a: &str, commit_b: Option<&str>, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[976](#976)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[977](#977)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[978](#978)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[979](#979)    }
[980](#980)
[981](#981)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[982](#982)    let cipher = maybe_load_cipher(&shard_dir)?;
[983](#983)
[984](#984)    let cid_b = match commit_b {
[985](#985)        Some(c) => branch::resolve_rev(&shard_dir, c)?,
[986](#986)        None => {
[987](#987)            let (_, head) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?;
[988](#988)            head.ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("no commits yet"))?
[989](#989)        }
[990](#990)    };
[991](#991)    let cid_a = branch::resolve_rev(&shard_dir, commit_a)?;
[992](#992)
[993](#993)    let commit1 = load_commit(&store, &cid_a)?;
[994](#994)    let commit2 = load_commit(&store, &cid_b)?;
[995](#995)
[996](#996)    let mut files1: HashMap<String, FileManifest> = HashMap::new();
[997](#997)    for mid in &commit1.manifests {
[998](#998)        let data = store.get_chunk(mid)?;
[999](#999)        let m: FileManifest = metadata::deserialize(&data)?;
[1000](#1000)        files1.insert(m.name.clone(), m);
[1001](#1001)    }
[1002](#1002)
[1003](#1003)    let mut files2: HashMap<String, FileManifest> = HashMap::new();
[1004](#1004)    for mid in &commit2.manifests {
[1005](#1005)        let data = store.get_chunk(mid)?;
[1006](#1006)        let m: FileManifest = metadata::deserialize(&data)?;
[1007](#1007)        files2.insert(m.name.clone(), m);
[1008](#1008)    }
[1009](#1009)
[1010](#1010)    let mut all_names: Vec<&String> = files1.keys().chain(files2.keys()).collect();
[1011](#1011)    all_names.sort();
[1012](#1012)    all_names.dedup();
[1013](#1013)
[1014](#1014)    let mut changes: Vec<serde_json::Value> = Vec::new();
[1015](#1015)    let mut diff_found = false;
[1016](#1016)
[1017](#1017)    for name in all_names {
[1018](#1018)        match (files1.get(name), files2.get(name)) {
[1019](#1019)            (None, Some(manifest)) => {
[1020](#1020)                let content = reconstruct_file(&store, manifest, cipher.as_ref())?;
[1021](#1021)                let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&content);
[1022](#1022)                diff_found = true;
[1023](#1023)                if json {
[1024](#1024)                    changes.push(serde_json::json!({
[1025](#1025)                        "type": "added",
[1026](#1026)                        "file": name,
[1027](#1027)                        "lines": text.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[1028](#1028)                    }));
[1029](#1029)                } else {
[1030](#1030)                    info!("--- /dev/null");
[1031](#1031)                    info!("+++ b/{}", name);
[1032](#1032)                    let lines: Vec<&str> = text.lines().collect();
[1033](#1033)                    info!("@@ -0,0 +1,{} @@", lines.len());
[1034](#1034)                    for line in &lines {
[1035](#1035)                        info!("+{}", line);
[1036](#1036)                    }
[1037](#1037)                }
[1038](#1038)            }
[1039](#1039)            (Some(manifest), None) => {
[1040](#1040)                let content = reconstruct_file(&store, manifest, cipher.as_ref())?;
[1041](#1041)                let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&content);
[1042](#1042)                diff_found = true;
[1043](#1043)                if json {
[1044](#1044)                    changes.push(serde_json::json!({
[1045](#1045)                        "type": "removed",
[1046](#1046)                        "file": name,
[1047](#1047)                        "lines": text.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[1048](#1048)                    }));
[1049](#1049)                } else {
[1050](#1050)                    info!("--- a/{}", name);
[1051](#1051)                    info!("+++ /dev/null");
[1052](#1052)                    let lines: Vec<&str> = text.lines().collect();
[1053](#1053)                    info!("@@ -1,{} +0,0 @@", lines.len());
[1054](#1054)                    for line in &lines {
[1055](#1055)                        info!("-{}", line);
[1056](#1056)                    }
[1057](#1057)                }
[1058](#1058)            }
[1059](#1059)            (Some(ma), Some(mb)) => {
[1060](#1060)                if ma.chunks == mb.chunks {
[1061](#1061)                    continue;
[1062](#1062)                }
[1063](#1063)                let content_a = reconstruct_file(&store, ma, cipher.as_ref())?;
[1064](#1064)                let content_b = reconstruct_file(&store, mb, cipher.as_ref())?;
[1065](#1065)                diff_found = true;
[1066](#1066)                if json {
[1067](#1067)                    let text_a = String::from_utf8_lossy(&content_a);
[1068](#1068)                    let text_b = String::from_utf8_lossy(&content_b);
[1069](#1069)                    changes.push(serde_json::json!({
[1070](#1070)                        "type": "modified",
[1071](#1071)                        "file": name,
[1072](#1072)                        "old_lines": text_a.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[1073](#1073)                        "new_lines": text_b.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[1074](#1074)                    }));
[1075](#1075)                } else {
[1076](#1076)                    let text_a = String::from_utf8_lossy(&content_a);
[1077](#1077)                    let text_b = String::from_utf8_lossy(&content_b);
[1078](#1078)                    let diff = TextDiff::from_lines(text_a.as_ref(), text_b.as_ref());
[1079](#1079)                    let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
[1080](#1080)                    diff.unified_diff()
[1081](#1081)                        .header(&format!("a/{}", name), &format!("b/{}", name))
[1082](#1082)                        .to_writer(&mut buf)
[1083](#1083)                        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("diff output error: {}", e))?;
[1084](#1084)                    let output = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf);
[1085](#1085)                    for line in output.lines() {
[1086](#1086)                        info!("{}", line);
[1087](#1087)                    }
[1088](#1088)                }
[1089](#1089)            }
[1090](#1090)            (None, None) => {}
[1091](#1091)        }
[1092](#1092)    }
[1093](#1093)
[1094](#1094)    if !diff_found {
[1095](#1095)        if json {
[1096](#1096)            info!(
[1097](#1097)                "{}",
[1098](#1098)                serde_json::to_string(
[1099](#1099)                    &serde_json::json!({"changes": changes, "message": "no differences"})
[1100](#1100)                )?
[1101](#1101)            );
[1102](#1102)        } else {
[1103](#1103)            info!("No differences between the commits.");
[1104](#1104)        }
[1105](#1105)        return Ok(());
[1106](#1106)    }
[1107](#1107)
[1108](#1108)    if json {
[1109](#1109)        info!(
[1110](#1110)            "{}",
[1111](#1111)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"changes": changes}))?
[1112](#1112)        );
[1113](#1113)    }
[1114](#1114)
[1115](#1115)    Ok(())
[1116](#1116)}
[1117](#1117)
[1118](#1118)pub fn checkout(path: &Path, target: &str, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[1119](#1119)    let _guard = OP_QUEUES
[1120](#1120)        .get_or_create(&path.to_path_buf())
[1121](#1121)        .acquire(ops::OpKind::Write, "checkout".to_string());
[1122](#1122)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[1123](#1123)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[1124](#1124)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[1125](#1125)    }
[1126](#1126)
[1127](#1127)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[1128](#1128)    let cipher = maybe_load_cipher(&shard_dir)?;
[1129](#1129)
[1130](#1130)    let branch_path = shard_dir.join("refs").join("heads").join(target);
[1133](#1133)    let commit_id = if branch_path.exists() {
[1134](#1134)        fs::read_to_string(&branch_path)?.trim().to_string()
[1135](#1135)    } else {
[1136](#1136)        target.to_string()
[1137](#1137)    };
[1138](#1138)
[1139](#1139)    let commit = load_commit(&store, &commit_id)?;
[1141](#1141)
[1142](#1142)    if branch_path.exists() {
[1144](#1144)        branch::set_head_branch(&shard_dir, target)?;
[1145](#1145)    } else {
[1146](#1146)        branch::set_head_commit(&shard_dir, target)?;
[1147](#1147)    }
[1148](#1148)    let mut files = Vec::new();
[1149](#1149)
[1150](#1150)    for manifest_id in &commit.manifests {
[1151](#1151)        let data = store.get_chunk(manifest_id)?;
[1152](#1152)        let hash = blake3::hash(&data);
[1153](#1153)        if hash.to_hex().to_string() != *manifest_id {
[1154](#1154)            anyhow::bail!("Manifest hash mismatch: {}", manifest_id);
[1155](#1155)        }
[1156](#1156)        let manifest: FileManifest = metadata::deserialize(&data)?;
[1157](#1157)        let compression = manifest.compression.parse::<Compression>()?;
[1158](#1158)        if !json {
[1159](#1159)            info!(
[1160](#1160)                "Checking out file: {} (compression: {})",
[1161](#1161)                manifest.name, manifest.compression
[1162](#1162)            );
[1163](#1163)        }
[1164](#1164)
[1165](#1165)        let mut file_data = Vec::new();
[1166](#1166)        for chunk_id in &manifest.chunks {
[1167](#1167)            let chunk_data = store.get_chunk(chunk_id)?;
[1168](#1168)            let decrypted = match &cipher {
[1169](#1169)                Some(c) => c.decrypt(&chunk_data)?,
[1170](#1170)                None => chunk_data,
[1171](#1171)            };
[1172](#1172)            let decompressed = compression.decompress(&decrypted)?;
[1173](#1173)            file_data.extend_from_slice(&decompressed);
[1174](#1174)        }
[1175](#1175)        fs::write(path.join(&manifest.name), file_data)?;
[1176](#1176)        if !json {
[1177](#1177)            info!("  -> {}", manifest.name);
[1178](#1178)        }
[1179](#1179)        files.push(manifest.name);
[1180](#1180)    }
[1181](#1181)
[1182](#1182)    if json {
[1183](#1183)        info!(
[1184](#1184)            "{}",
[1185](#1185)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[1186](#1186)                "commit_id": commit_id,
[1187](#1187)                "files": files,
[1188](#1188)            }))?
[1189](#1189)        );
[1190](#1190)    } else {
[1191](#1191)        info!("Checkout complete.");
[1192](#1192)    }
[1193](#1193)    Ok(())
[1194](#1194)}
[1195](#1195)
[1196](#1196)pub fn status(path: &Path, json: bool, porcelain: bool) -> Result<()> {
[1197](#1197)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[1198](#1198)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[1199](#1199)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[1200](#1200)    }
[1201](#1201)
[1202](#1202)    let config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[1203](#1203)    let fmt = MetadataFormat::from_config(&config);
[1204](#1204)
[1205](#1205)    let (current_branch, head_commit) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?;
[1206](#1206)    let mut commit_id: Option<String> = None;
[1207](#1207)    if let Some(cid) = head_commit {
[1208](#1208)        commit_id = Some(cid);
[1209](#1209)        if !json && !porcelain {
[1210](#1210)            if let Some(ref branch) = current_branch {
[1211](#1211)                info!("On branch: {}", branch);
[1212](#1212)            } else {
[1213](#1213)                info!("HEAD detached at {}", commit_id.as_ref().unwrap());
[1214](#1214)            }
[1215](#1215)        }
[1216](#1216)    } else if !json && !porcelain {
[1217](#1217)        info!("No commits yet.");
[1218](#1218)    }
[1219](#1219)
[1220](#1220)    let index = Index::load(&shard_dir.join("index"), &fmt)?;
[1221](#1221)    let staged: Vec<String> = index.files.keys().cloned().collect();
[1222](#1222)    if !json && !porcelain {
[1223](#1223)        if staged.is_empty() {
[1224](#1224)            info!("Nothing staged.");
[1225](#1225)        } else {
[1226](#1226)            info!("\nStaged files:");
[1227](#1227)            for name in &staged {
[1228](#1228)                info!("  {} (to be committed)", name);
[1229](#1229)            }
[1230](#1230)        }
[1231](#1231)    }
[1232](#1232)
[1233](#1233)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[1234](#1234)    let mut deleted = Vec::new();
[1235](#1235)    let tracked_names: std::collections::HashSet<String> = if let Some(head) = &commit_id {
[1236](#1236)        let mut names = std::collections::HashSet::new();
[1237](#1237)        if let Ok(commit) = load_commit(&store, head) {
[1238](#1238)            for manifest_id in &commit.manifests {
[1239](#1239)                if let Ok(data) = store.get_chunk(manifest_id) {
[1240](#1240)                    if let Ok(manifest) = metadata::deserialize::<FileManifest>(&data) {
[1241](#1241)                        let file_path = path.join(&manifest.name);
[1242](#1242)                        if !file_path.exists() {
[1243](#1243)                            deleted.push(manifest.name.clone());
[1244](#1244)                        }
[1245](#1245)                        names.insert(manifest.name);
[1246](#1246)                    }
[1247](#1247)                }
[1248](#1248)            }
[1249](#1249)        }
[1250](#1250)        names
[1251](#1251)    } else {
[1252](#1252)        std::collections::HashSet::new()
[1253](#1253)    };
[1254](#1254)
[1255](#1255)    if !json && !porcelain && !deleted.is_empty() {
[1256](#1256)        info!("\nDeleted files:");
[1257](#1257)        for name in &deleted {
[1258](#1258)            info!("  {} (deleted)", name);
[1259](#1259)        }
[1260](#1260)    }
[1261](#1261)
[1262](#1262)    let mut untracked = Vec::new();
[1263](#1263)    let config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[1264](#1264)    let include_hidden = config
[1265](#1265)        .get("hidden_files_enabled")
[1266](#1266)        .map(|s| s.as_str() == "true")
[1267](#1267)        .unwrap_or(false);
[1268](#1268)
[1269](#1269)    let mut builder = ignore::WalkBuilder::new(path);
[1270](#1270)    builder.hidden(!include_hidden);
[1271](#1271)    builder.add_custom_ignore_filename(".shardignore");
[1272](#1272)
[1273](#1273)    for entry in builder.build().filter_map(|e| e.ok()) {
[1274](#1274)        if entry.depth() > 0
[1275](#1275)            && (entry
[1276](#1276)                .file_type()
[1277](#1277)                .is_some_and(|ft| ft.is_file() || ft.is_dir()))
[1278](#1278)        {
[1279](#1279)            let rel_path = entry.path().strip_prefix(path).unwrap_or(entry.path());
[1280](#1280)            let name = rel_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
[1281](#1281)
[1282](#1282)            let is_hidden = rel_path.components().any(|c| {
[1283](#1283)                let name = c.as_os_str().to_string_lossy();
[1284](#1284)                name == ".shard" || name == ".git"
[1285](#1285)            });
[1286](#1286)
[1287](#1287)            if !is_hidden
[1288](#1288)                && entry.path() != shard_dir
[1289](#1289)                && !entry.path().starts_with(&shard_dir)
[1290](#1290)                && !index.files.contains_key(&name)
[1291](#1291)                && !tracked_names.contains(&name)
[1292](#1292)                && entry.file_type().is_some_and(|ft| ft.is_file())
[1293](#1293)            {
[1294](#1294)                untracked.push(name);
[1295](#1295)            }
[1296](#1296)        }
[1297](#1297)    }
[1298](#1298)    if !json && !porcelain && !untracked.is_empty() {
[1299](#1299)        info!("\nUntracked files:");
[1300](#1300)        for name in &untracked {
[1301](#1301)            info!("  {}", name);
[1302](#1302)        }
[1303](#1303)    }
[1304](#1304)
[1305](#1305)    if porcelain {
[1306](#1306)        for name in &staged {
[1307](#1307)            println!("A  {}", name);
[1308](#1308)        }
[1309](#1309)        for name in &deleted {
[1310](#1310)            println!(" D {}", name);
[1311](#1311)        }
[1312](#1312)        for name in &untracked {
[1313](#1313)            println!("?? {}", name);
[1314](#1314)        }
[1315](#1315)        return Ok(());
[1316](#1316)    }
[1317](#1317)
[1318](#1318)    if json {
[1319](#1319)        info!(
[1320](#1320)            "{}",
[1321](#1321)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[1322](#1322)                "commit": commit_id,
[1323](#1323)                "staged": staged,
[1324](#1324)                "deleted": deleted,
[1325](#1325)                "untracked": untracked,
[1326](#1326)            }))?
[1327](#1327)        );
[1328](#1328)    }
[1329](#1329)
[1330](#1330)    Ok(())
[1331](#1331)}
[1332](#1332)
[1333](#1333)fn load_config(shard_dir: &Path) -> Result<std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>> {
[1334](#1334)    let config_path = shard_dir.join("config.json");
[1335](#1335)    let mut config: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String> = if config_path.exists() {
[1336](#1336)        let data = fs::read(&config_path)?;
[1337](#1337)        metadata::deserialize(&data)?
[1338](#1338)    } else {
[1339](#1339)        std::collections::BTreeMap::new()
[1340](#1340)    };
[1341](#1341)    let overrides = config::load_env_overrides();
[1342](#1342)    for (k, v) in overrides {
[1343](#1343)        config.insert(k, v);
[1344](#1344)    }
[1345](#1345)    Ok(config)
[1346](#1346)}

[1358](#1358)fn global_keys_dir() -> Option<PathBuf> {
[1359](#1359)    std::env::var("HOME")
[1360](#1360)        .ok()
[1361](#1361)        .map(|h| Path::new(&h).join(".shard").join("keys"))
[1362](#1362)}
[1363](#1363)
[1364](#1364)fn load_keypair(shard_dir: &Path) -> Result<KeyPair> {
[1365](#1365)    let local = shard_dir.join("keys");
[1366](#1366)    if local.join("secret.key").exists() {
[1367](#1367)        match KeyPair::load(&local) {
[1368](#1368)            Ok(kp) => return Ok(kp),
[1369](#1369)            Err(e) => {
[1370](#1370)                if e.to_string().contains("encrypted") {
[1371](#1371)                    if let Some(passphrase) = get_cached_passphrase() {
[1372](#1372)                        return KeyPair::load_with_passphrase(&local, &passphrase);
[1373](#1373)                    }
[1374](#1374)                    anyhow::bail!(
[1375](#1375)                        "secret.key is encrypted. Use `shard unlock --passphrase <pass>` or provide --passphrase"
[1376](#1376)                    );
[1377](#1377)                }
[1378](#1378)                return Err(e);
[1379](#1379)            }
[1380](#1380)        }
[1381](#1381)    }
[1382](#1382)    if let Some(global) = global_keys_dir() {
[1383](#1383)        if global.join("secret.key").exists() {
[1384](#1384)            match KeyPair::load(&global) {
[1385](#1385)                Ok(kp) => return Ok(kp),
[1386](#1386)                Err(e) => {
[1387](#1387)                    if e.to_string().contains("encrypted") {
[1388](#1388)                        if let Some(passphrase) = get_cached_passphrase() {
[1389](#1389)                            return KeyPair::load_with_passphrase(&global, &passphrase);
[1390](#1390)                        }
[1391](#1391)                    }
[1392](#1392)                    return Err(e);
[1393](#1393)                }
[1394](#1394)            }
[1395](#1395)        }
[1396](#1396)    }
[1397](#1397)    anyhow::bail!("no keypair found in {} or ~/.shard/keys/", local.display())
[1398](#1398)}
[1399](#1399)
[1400](#1400)fn load_public_key(shard_dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
[1401](#1401)    let local = shard_dir.join("keys/public.key");
[1402](#1402)    if local.exists() {
[1403](#1403)        return Ok(fs::read(&local)?);
[1404](#1404)    }
[1405](#1405)    if let Some(global) = global_keys_dir() {
[1406](#1406)        let gp = global.join("public.key");
[1407](#1407)        if gp.exists() {
[1408](#1408)            return Ok(fs::read(&gp)?);
[1409](#1409)        }
[1410](#1410)    }
[1411](#1411)    anyhow::bail!(
[1412](#1412)        "no public key found in {} or ~/.shard/keys/",
[1413](#1413)        local.display()
[1414](#1414)    )

[1417](#1417)fn maybe_load_cipher(shard_dir: &Path) -> Result<Option<encryption::RepoCipher>> {
[1418](#1418)    let config = load_config(shard_dir)?;
[1419](#1419)    if config.get("private").map(|s| s.as_str()) == Some("true") {
[1420](#1420)        let key = encryption::load_repo_key(&shard_dir.join("keys"))?;
[1421](#1421)        Ok(Some(encryption::RepoCipher::from_key(&key)))
[1422](#1422)    } else {
[1423](#1423)        Ok(None)

[1427](#1427)pub fn config_get(path: &Path, key: Option<&str>) -> Result<()> {
[1428](#1428)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");

[1431](#1431)    }

[1433](#1433)    if let Some(key) = key {
[1434](#1434)        match config.get(key) {
[1435](#1435)            Some(value) => info!("{} = {}", key, value),
[1436](#1436)            None => anyhow::bail!("config key not found: {}", key),
[1437](#1437)        }
[1438](#1438)    } else {

[1477](#1477)pub fn tag_add(path: &Path, name: &str, commit_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
[1478](#1478)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[1479](#1479)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[1480](#1480)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[1481](#1481)    }
[1482](#1482)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[1484](#1484)    load_commit(&store, commit_id)?;
[1485](#1485)    let mut tags = load_tags(&shard_dir)?;
[1486](#1486)    tags.insert(name.to_string(), commit_id.to_string());
[1487](#1487)    save_tags(&shard_dir, &tags)?;
[1488](#1488)    info!("Tagged '{}' -> {}", name, commit_id);
[1489](#1489)    Ok(())
[1490](#1490)}

[1518](#1518)pub fn branch_list(path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
[1519](#1519)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[1520](#1520)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[1521](#1521)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[1522](#1522)    }

[1525](#1525)        info!("No branches.");
[1526](#1526)        return Ok(());
[1527](#1527)    }
[1528](#1528)    for (name, commit_id) in &branches {

[1530](#1530)            "* "
[1531](#1531)        } else {
[1532](#1532)            "  "
[1533](#1533)        };

[1535](#1535)            "{}{} ({})",
[1536](#1536)            prefix,
[1537](#1537)            name,
[1538](#1538)            &commit_id[..8.min(commit_id.len())]
[1539](#1539)        );
[1540](#1540)    }
[1541](#1541)    Ok(())

[1544](#1544)pub fn merge(path: &Path, branch: &str, message: &str, author: &str, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[1545](#1545)    let _guard = OP_QUEUES
[1546](#1546)        .get_or_create(&path.to_path_buf())
[1547](#1547)        .acquire(ops::OpKind::Write, "merge".to_string());
[1548](#1548)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[1549](#1549)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[1550](#1550)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[1551](#1551)    }
[1552](#1552)
[1553](#1553)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[1554](#1554)
[1555](#1555)    let config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[1556](#1556)    let fmt = MetadataFormat::from_config(&config);
[1557](#1557)
[1558](#1558)    let (current_branch, current_id) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?;
[1560](#1560)    let current_id =
[1561](#1561)        current_id.ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("No commits yet — nothing to merge into"))?;
[1562](#1562)
[1563](#1563)    let source_id = branch::resolve_rev(&shard_dir, branch)?;
[1565](#1565)    if source_id == current_id {
[1566](#1566)        anyhow::bail!("Already up to date — source is the same commit as HEAD");
[1567](#1567)    }
[1568](#1568)
[1569](#1569)    let current_commit = load_commit(&store, ¤t_id)?;
[1571](#1571)    let source_commit = load_commit(&store, &source_id)?;
[1572](#1572)
[1573](#1573)    let mut merged_manifests: std::collections::HashMap<String, (String, Vec<String>)> =
[1575](#1575)        std::collections::HashMap::new();
[1576](#1576)
[1577](#1577)    for manifest_id in ¤t_commit.manifests {
[1578](#1578)        let data = store.get_chunk(manifest_id)?;
[1579](#1579)        let manifest: FileManifest = metadata::deserialize(&data)?;
[1580](#1580)        merged_manifests.insert(manifest.name.clone(), (manifest.name, manifest.chunks));
[1581](#1581)    }
[1582](#1582)
[1583](#1583)    for manifest_id in &source_commit.manifests {
[1584](#1584)        let data = store.get_chunk(manifest_id)?;
[1585](#1585)        let manifest: FileManifest = metadata::deserialize(&data)?;
[1586](#1586)        merged_manifests.insert(manifest.name.clone(), (manifest.name, manifest.chunks));
[1587](#1587)    }
[1588](#1588)
[1589](#1589)    let timestamp = SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)?.as_secs();
[1591](#1591)    let keys = load_keypair(&shard_dir)?;
[1592](#1592)    let signing_key = keys.signing_key;
[1593](#1593)    let mut merged_manifest_ids = Vec::new();
[1594](#1594)    for (name, chunks) in merged_manifests.values() {
[1595](#1595)        let compression = Compression::None;
[1596](#1596)        let mut manifest = FileManifest {
[1597](#1597)            name: name.clone(),
[1598](#1598)            size: 0,
[1599](#1599)            chunks: chunks.clone(),
[1600](#1600)            content_type: None,
[1601](#1601)            compression: compression.as_str().to_string(),
[1602](#1602)            merkle_root: Some(FileManifest::merkle_root(chunks)),
[1603](#1603)            created_by: Some(author.to_string()),
[1604](#1604)            created_at: Some(timestamp),
[1605](#1605)            signature: None,
[1606](#1606)        };
[1607](#1607)
[1608](#1608)        let mut unsigned = manifest.clone();
[1609](#1609)        unsigned.signature = None;
[1610](#1610)        let canonical = metadata::serialize_for_signing(&unsigned);
[1611](#1611)        let sig = signing_key.sign(&canonical);
[1612](#1612)        manifest.signature = Some(hex::encode(sig.to_bytes()));
[1613](#1613)
[1614](#1614)        let encoded = metadata::serialize(&manifest, &fmt);
[1615](#1615)        let hash = blake3::hash(&encoded);
[1616](#1616)        store.put_chunk(&crate::chunker::Chunk {
[1617](#1617)            hash,
[1618](#1618)            data: encoded,
[1619](#1619)            offset: 0,
[1620](#1620)        })?;
[1621](#1621)        merged_manifest_ids.push(hash.to_hex().to_string());
[1622](#1622)    }
[1623](#1623)    merged_manifest_ids.sort();
[1624](#1624)
[1625](#1625)    let public_key_hex = hex::encode(keys.verifying_key.to_bytes());
[1627](#1627)    let key_id = keychain::get_current_key_id(&shard_dir.join("keys")).ok();
[1628](#1628)    let parents = vec![current_id.clone(), source_id.clone()];
[1629](#1629)    let mut commit = Commit {
[1630](#1630)        commit_id: String::new(),
[1631](#1631)        parents,
[1632](#1632)        manifests: merged_manifest_ids,
[1633](#1633)        author: author.to_string(),
[1634](#1634)        message: message.to_string(),
[1635](#1635)        timestamp,
[1636](#1636)        public_key: Some(public_key_hex),
[1637](#1637)        signature: None,
[1638](#1638)        key_id,
[1639](#1639)    };
[1640](#1640)
[1641](#1641)    let json_unsigned = metadata::serialize_for_signing(&commit);
[1642](#1642)    let signature = signing_key.sign(&json_unsigned);
[1643](#1643)    commit.signature = Some(hex::encode(signature.to_bytes()));
[1644](#1644)
[1645](#1645)    let encoded = metadata::serialize(&commit, &fmt);
[1646](#1646)    let hash = blake3::hash(&encoded);
[1647](#1647)    store.put_chunk(&crate::chunker::Chunk {
[1648](#1648)        hash,
[1649](#1649)        data: encoded,
[1650](#1650)        offset: 0,
[1651](#1651)    })?;
[1652](#1652)
[1653](#1653)    let merge_commit_id = hash.to_hex().to_string();
[1654](#1654)
[1655](#1655)    if has_dag_cycle(&store, &commit.parents, &merge_commit_id)? {
[1657](#1657)        anyhow::bail!(
[1658](#1658)            "Cycle detected in merge: commit {} is already an ancestor of one or more parents",
[1659](#1659)            merge_commit_id
[1660](#1660)        );
[1661](#1661)    }
[1662](#1662)
[1663](#1663)    if let Some(ref branch_name) = current_branch {
[1665](#1665)        branch::update_branch_ref(&shard_dir, branch_name, &merge_commit_id)?;
[1666](#1666)        branch::set_head_branch(&shard_dir, branch_name)?;
[1667](#1667)    } else {
[1668](#1668)        branch::set_head_commit(&shard_dir, &merge_commit_id)?;
[1669](#1669)    }
[1670](#1670)
[1671](#1671)    if json {
[1672](#1672)        info!(
[1673](#1673)            "{}",
[1674](#1674)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[1675](#1675)                "commit_id": merge_commit_id,
[1676](#1676)                "message": message,
[1677](#1677)            }))?
[1678](#1678)        );
[1679](#1679)    } else {
[1680](#1680)        info!("Merge commit {} ({})", merge_commit_id, message);
[1681](#1681)    }
[1682](#1682)    Ok(())
[1683](#1683)}

[1685](#1685)pub fn tag_list(path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
[1686](#1686)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[1687](#1687)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[1688](#1688)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[1689](#1689)    }
[1690](#1690)    let tags = load_tags(&shard_dir)?;
[1691](#1691)    if tags.is_empty() {
[1692](#1692)        info!("No tags.");
[1693](#1693)    } else {
[1694](#1694)        for (name, commit_id) in &tags {
[1695](#1695)            info!("{} -> {}", name, commit_id);

[1700](#1700)
[1701](#1701)fn collect_reachable(
[1702](#1702)    store: &Store,
[1703](#1703)    commit_id: &str,
[1704](#1704)    seen_commits: &mut std::collections::HashSet<String>,
[1705](#1705)    reachable: &mut std::collections::HashSet<String>,
[1706](#1706)) -> Result<()> {
[1707](#1707)    if !seen_commits.insert(commit_id.to_string()) {
[1708](#1708)        return Ok(());
[1709](#1709)    }
[1710](#1710)
[1711](#1711)    reachable.insert(commit_id.to_string());
[1712](#1712)
[1713](#1713)    let commit = match load_commit(store, commit_id) {
[1714](#1714)        Ok(c) => c,
[1715](#1715)        Err(_) => return Ok(()),
[1716](#1716)    };
[1717](#1717)
[1718](#1718)    for manifest_id in &commit.manifests {
[1719](#1719)        reachable.insert(manifest_id.clone());
[1720](#1720)
[1721](#1721)        if let Ok(data) = store.get_chunk(manifest_id) {
[1722](#1722)            if let Ok(manifest) = metadata::deserialize::<FileManifest>(&data) {
[1723](#1723)                for chunk_id in &manifest.chunks {
[1724](#1724)                    reachable.insert(chunk_id.clone());
[1725](#1725)                }
[1726](#1726)            }
[1727](#1727)        }
[1728](#1728)    }
[1729](#1729)
[1730](#1730)    for parent_id in &commit.parents {
[1731](#1731)        collect_reachable(store, parent_id, seen_commits, reachable)?;
[1732](#1732)    }
[1733](#1733)
[1734](#1734)    Ok(())
[1735](#1735)}
[1736](#1736)
[1737](#1737)pub fn prune(path: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[1738](#1738)    let _guard = OP_QUEUES
[1739](#1739)        .get_or_create(&path.to_path_buf())
[1740](#1740)        .acquire(ops::OpKind::Write, "prune".to_string());
[1741](#1741)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[1742](#1742)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[1743](#1743)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[1744](#1744)    }
[1745](#1745)
[1746](#1746)    let config = load_config(&shard_dir)?;
[1747](#1747)    let fmt = MetadataFormat::from_config(&config);
[1748](#1748)
[1749](#1749)    let store = Store::open(&shard_dir)?;
[1750](#1750)    let mut reachable: std::collections::HashSet<String> = std::collections::HashSet::new();
[1751](#1751)
[1752](#1752)    let (_, head_commit) = branch::resolve_head(&shard_dir)?;
[1754](#1754)    if let Some(ref head) = head_commit {
[1755](#1755)        collect_reachable(
[1756](#1756)            &store,
[1757](#1757)            head,
[1758](#1758)            &mut std::collections::HashSet::new(),
[1759](#1759)            &mut reachable,
[1760](#1760)        )?;
[1761](#1761)    }
[1762](#1762)
[1763](#1763)    if let Ok(branches) = branch::list_branches(&shard_dir) {
[1765](#1765)        for (_, commit_id) in branches.1 {
[1766](#1766)            collect_reachable(
[1767](#1767)                &store,
[1768](#1768)                &commit_id,
[1769](#1769)                &mut std::collections::HashSet::new(),
[1770](#1770)                &mut reachable,
[1771](#1771)            )?;
[1772](#1772)        }
[1773](#1773)    }
[1774](#1774)
[1775](#1775)    let tags = load_tags(&shard_dir)?;
[1777](#1777)    for commit_id in tags.values() {
[1778](#1778)        collect_reachable(
[1779](#1779)            &store,
[1780](#1780)            commit_id,
[1781](#1781)            &mut std::collections::HashSet::new(),
[1782](#1782)            &mut reachable,
[1783](#1783)        )?;
[1784](#1784)    }
[1785](#1785)
[1786](#1786)    let index = Index::load(&shard_dir.join("index"), &fmt)?;
[1788](#1788)    for manifest in index.files.values() {
[1789](#1789)        let json = metadata::serialize(manifest, &fmt);
[1790](#1790)        let hash = blake3::hash(&json);
[1791](#1791)        let hash_hex = hash.to_hex().to_string();
[1792](#1792)        reachable.insert(hash_hex);
[1793](#1793)        for chunk_hash in &manifest.chunks {
[1794](#1794)            reachable.insert(chunk_hash.clone());
[1795](#1795)        }
[1796](#1796)    }
[1797](#1797)
[1798](#1798)    let all_chunks = store.iter_chunks()?;
[1800](#1800)    let mut pruned = 0u64;
[1801](#1801)    let mut kept = 0u64;
[1802](#1802)    for (hash_hex, full_path) in &all_chunks {
[1803](#1803)        if !reachable.contains(hash_hex) {
[1804](#1804)            store.delete_chunk(hash_hex, Some(full_path))?;
[1805](#1805)            pruned += 1;
[1806](#1806)        } else {
[1807](#1807)            kept += 1;
[1808](#1808)        }
[1809](#1809)    }
[1810](#1810)
[1811](#1811)    if json {
[1812](#1812)        info!(
[1813](#1813)            "{}",
[1814](#1814)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[1815](#1815)                "pruned": pruned,
[1816](#1816)                "remaining": kept,
[1817](#1817)            }))?
[1818](#1818)        );
[1819](#1819)    } else {
[1820](#1820)        info!("Pruned {} objects. {} objects remain.", pruned, kept);
[1821](#1821)    }
[1822](#1822)    Ok(())
[1823](#1823)}
[1824](#1824)
[1825](#1825)pub fn peer_add(path: &Path, multiaddr: &str, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[1826](#1826)    let shard_dir = path.join(".shard");
[1827](#1827)    if !shard_dir.exists() {
[1828](#1828)        anyhow::bail!("not a shard repository (run `shard init` first)");
[1829](#1829)    }
[1830](#1830)
[1831](#1831)    if multiaddr.is_empty() || multiaddr.parse::<shard_net::libp2p::Multiaddr>().is_err() {
[1833](#1833)        anyhow::bail!("invalid multiaddr '{}' (must be a valid libp2p multiaddr, e.g. /ip4/1.2.3.4/tcp/5678/p2p/...)", multiaddr);
[1834](#1834)    }
[1835](#1835)
[1836](#1836)    let peers_path = shard_dir.join("peers.json");
[1837](#1837)    let mut peers: Vec<String> = if peers_path.exists() {
[1838](#1838)        let data = fs::read(&peers_path)?;
[1839](#1839)        serde_json::from_slice(&data)?
[1840](#1840)    } else {
[1841](#1841)        Vec::new()
[1842](#1842)    };
[1843](#1843)
[1844](#1844)    let added = if !peers.contains(&multiaddr.to_string()) {
[1845](#1845)        peers.push(multiaddr.to_string());
[1846](#1846)        let data = serde_json::to_vec(&peers)?;
[1847](#1847)        fs::write(peers_path, data)?;
[1848](#1848)        true
[1849](#1849)    } else {
[1850](#1850)        false
[1851](#1851)    };
[1852](#1852)
[1853](#1853)    if json {
[1854](#1854)        info!(
[1855](#1855)            "{}",
[1856](#1856)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({
[1857](#1857)                "multiaddr": multiaddr,
[1858](#1858)                "added": added,
[1859](#1859)            }))?
[1860](#1860)        );
[1861](#1861)    } else if added {
[1862](#1862)        info!("Added peer: {}", multiaddr);
[1863](#1863)    } else {
[1864](#1864)        info!("Peer already exists: {}", multiaddr);
[1865](#1865)    }
[1866](#1866)
[1867](#1867)    Ok(())
[1868](#1868)}

[1874](#1874)        Ok(serde_json::from_slice(&data)?)
[1875](#1875)    } else {

[1879](#1879)
[1880](#1880)fn authorized_keys_path(shard_dir: &Path) -> std::path::PathBuf {
[1881](#1881)    shard_dir.join("authorized_keys")
[1882](#1882)}
[1883](#1883)
[1884](#1884)struct AuthorizedKeyEntry {
[1886](#1886)    key: ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey,
[1887](#1887)    comment: String,
[1888](#1888)}
[1889](#1889)
[1890](#1890)fn parse_authorized_key_line(line: &str) -> Option<AuthorizedKeyEntry> {
[1891](#1891)    let line = line.trim();
[1892](#1892)    if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#') {
[1893](#1893)        return None;
[1894](#1894)    }
[1895](#1895)    let parts: Vec<&str> = line.splitn(2, char::is_whitespace).collect();
[1897](#1897)    let hex_key = parts[0].trim();
[1898](#1898)    let comment = parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&"").trim().to_string();
[1899](#1899)    let bytes = hex::decode(hex_key).ok()?;
[1900](#1900)    let arr: [u8; 32] = bytes.try_into().ok()?;
[1901](#1901)    let key = ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&arr).ok()?;
[1902](#1902)    Some(AuthorizedKeyEntry { key, comment })
[1903](#1903)}
[1904](#1904)
[1905](#1905)fn load_authorized_keys(shard_dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey>> {
[1906](#1906)    let path = authorized_keys_path(shard_dir);
[1907](#1907)    if !path.exists() {
[1908](#1908)        return Ok(Vec::new());
[1909](#1909)    }
[1910](#1910)    let content = fs::read_to_string(&path)?;
[1911](#1911)    let mut keys = Vec::new();
[1912](#1912)    for line in content.lines() {
[1913](#1913)        if let Some(entry) = parse_authorized_key_line(line) {
[1914](#1914)            keys.push(entry.key);
[1915](#1915)        }
[1916](#1916)    }
[1917](#1917)    Ok(keys)
[1918](#1918)}
[1919](#1919)
[1920](#1920)pub fn add_authorized_key(shard_dir: &Path, public_key_hex: &str) -> Result<()> {
[1921](#1921)    let bytes = hex::decode(public_key_hex)?;
[1923](#1923)    let arr: [u8; 32] = bytes
[1924](#1924)        .as_slice()
[1925](#1925)        .try_into()
[1926](#1926)        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("Public key must be 32 bytes (64 hex chars)"))?;
[1927](#1927)    let _pk = ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&arr)?;
[1928](#1928)
[1929](#1929)    let path = authorized_keys_path(shard_dir);
[1930](#1930)    let mut content = if path.exists() {
[1931](#1931)        fs::read_to_string(&path)?
[1932](#1932)    } else {
[1933](#1933)        String::new()
[1934](#1934)    };
[1935](#1935)    if content.lines().any(|l| {
[1937](#1937)        if let Some(entry) = parse_authorized_key_line(l) {
[1938](#1938)            entry.key.to_bytes().to_vec() == arr.to_vec()
[1939](#1939)        } else {
[1940](#1940)            false
[1941](#1941)        }
[1942](#1942)    }) {
[1943](#1943)        info!("Key already authorized");
[1944](#1944)        return Ok(());
[1945](#1945)    }
[1946](#1946)    content.push_str(public_key_hex);
[1947](#1947)    content.push('\n');
[1948](#1948)    fs::write(&path, content)?;
[1949](#1949)    info!("Authorized key added");
[1950](#1950)    Ok(())
[1951](#1951)}
[1952](#1952)
[1953](#1953)pub fn remove_authorized_key(shard_dir: &Path, public_key_hex: &str) -> Result<()> {
[1954](#1954)    let path = authorized_keys_path(shard_dir);
[1955](#1955)    if !path.exists() {
[1956](#1956)        anyhow::bail!("authorized_keys file does not exist");
[1957](#1957)    }
[1958](#1958)    let content = fs::read_to_string(&path)?;
[1959](#1959)    let new_content: Vec<&str> = content
[1960](#1960)        .lines()
[1961](#1961)        .filter(|l| {
[1962](#1962)            if let Some(entry) = parse_authorized_key_line(l) {
[1963](#1963)                hex::encode(entry.key.to_bytes()) != public_key_hex
[1964](#1964)            } else {
[1965](#1965)                true
[1966](#1966)            }
[1967](#1967)        })
[1968](#1968)        .collect();
[1969](#1969)    if new_content.len() == content.lines().count() {
[1970](#1970)        anyhow::bail!("Key not found in authorized_keys");
[1971](#1971)    }
[1972](#1972)    let has_keys = new_content
[1973](#1973)        .iter()
[1974](#1974)        .any(|l| parse_authorized_key_line(l).is_some());
[1975](#1975)    if has_keys {
[1976](#1976)        fs::write(&path, new_content.join("\n") + "\n")?;
[1977](#1977)    } else {
[1978](#1978)        fs::remove_file(&path)?;
[1979](#1979)    }
[1980](#1980)    info!("Authorized key removed");
[1981](#1981)    Ok(())
[1982](#1982)}
[1983](#1983)
[1984](#1984)pub fn list_authorized_keys(shard_dir: &Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {
[1985](#1985)    let path = authorized_keys_path(shard_dir);
[1986](#1986)    if !path.exists() {
[1987](#1987)        if json {
[1988](#1988)            info!(
[1989](#1989)                "{}",
[1990](#1990)                serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"keys": []}))?
[1991](#1991)            );
[1992](#1992)        } else {
[1993](#1993)            println!("No authorized keys.");
[1994](#1994)        }
[1995](#1995)        return Ok(());
[1996](#1996)    }
[1997](#1997)    let content = fs::read_to_string(&path)?;
[1998](#1998)    let mut entries = Vec::new();
[1999](#1999)    for line in content.lines() {
[2000](#2000)        if let Some(entry) = parse_authorized_key_line(line) {
[2001](#2001)            entries.push(serde_json::json!({
[2002](#2002)                "key": hex::encode(entry.key.to_bytes()),
[2003](#2003)                "comment": entry.comment,
[2004](#2004)            }));
[2005](#2005)        }
[2006](#2006)    }
[2007](#2007)    if entries.is_empty() {
[2008](#2008)        if json {
[2009](#2009)            info!(
[2010](#2010)                "{}",
[2011](#2011)                serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"keys": []}))?
[2012](#2012)            );
[2013](#2013)        } else {
[2014](#2014)            println!("No authorized keys.");
[2015](#2015)        }
[2016](#2016)        return Ok(());
[2017](#2017)    }
[2018](#2018)    if json {
[2019](#2019)        info!(
[2020](#2020)            "{}",
[2021](#2021)            serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"keys": entries}))?
[2022](#2022)        );
[2023](#2023)    } else {
[2024](#2024)        for e in &entries {
[2025](#2025)            let comment = e["comment"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
[2026](#2026)            if comment.is_empty() {
[2027](#2027)                println!("  {}", e["key"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
[2028](#2028)            } else {
[2029](#2029)                println!("  {}  {}", e["key"].as_str().unwrap_or(""), comment);
[2030](#2030)            }
[2031](#2031)        }
[2032](#2032)    }
[2033](#2033)    Ok(())
[2034](#2034)}
